title: Exploring Reasoning Biases in Large Language Models Through Syllogism: Insights from the NeuBAROCO Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on syllogistic reasoning tasks where the conclusions are either congruent or incongruent with human commonsense beliefs.
Testing if models erroneously classify invalid inferences as valid (entailment) by illicitly reversing the order of terms in quantified sentences containing 'all' or 'some-not'.
Assessing if models preferentially select logically invalid conclusions simply because they share the same quantifiers or logical structure (e.g., 'some', 'no') as the premises.
